rule: A runtime product is FIT only when every field required for exact historical reconstruction is directly persisted in an authorized canonical relation, deterministically derivable from another exact authoritative relation/profile, or stored in an explicitly authorized object/snapshot payload. Audit payloads, unrelated JSON columns, or ad-hoc object blobs may not be used as shadow authority.

notes: Existing SQLiteCorePublicationLedger/PostgreSQLCorePublicationLedger already implement the qualified publication path.
B2 wiring is still required, but the frozen logical model contains dedicated longitudinal authority relations.

derivable: uncertainty_method/uncertainty_level from exact adopted attribution execution profile
logical_hash only after all logical fields are reconstructable
authorized_payload: cohort query/manifest detail may reside in registry.dataset_snapshot.query_or_manifest
model artifact bytes/diagnostics may reside behind model_artifact_uri/hash and registry.object_reference

blockers.reason: No canonical membership relation binds adjusted_capability_estimate to a P2 analysis_release; object_binding cannot be invented without a governed object authority for every estimate.
No dedicated canonical field or governed relation stores the exact ordered reason-code set; status/diagnostics do not guarantee lossless reconstruction.
assessment.attribution_run has no request/input hash and no governed link to registry.compute_job.

derivable: P3CapabilityEstimate.claim_level from the exact admitted P3 execution profile/authority
observed and adjusted layer evidence from exact P1/P2 upstream identities
model_object_ref_id and surface_object_ref_id from exact managed_uri/hash registry.object_reference bindings
authorized_payload: model build coefficients/fit metadata in immutable model artifact payload
surface dataset in immutable surface object payload

derivable: P3 claim/validity/as-of/uncertainty may be resolved from exact capability_projection_refs when an exact P3 estimate link is present
objective_result_refs may be resolved from assessment.objective_result rows keyed by mission_assessment_id

blockers.reason: actor_assessment has no authoritative subject-context or role-model relation preserving these exact revision fields.
No canonical relation binds annotation revisions to actor_assessment or stores the assessment approval state; audit_log is append-only evidence, not the frozen assessment state authority.
mission_assessment stores participant_ids UUID[] but no governed composition identity or pseudonymous subject-key membership needed for exact P5 reconstruction.
No canonical columns or dedicated relations preserve these revision semantics.
Hash is derivable only if every authoritative logical field can be reconstructed; blockers above prevent this.

direct_fit: P6 input snapshot core snapshot identity -> registry.dataset_snapshot
derivable: source/model identities may be resolved through exact input snapshot/model relations where explicit IDs exist
authorized_payload: model artifact payload may carry model-build coefficients and fit diagnostics
counterfactual projection dataset may remain object-backed through projection_dataset_uri/hash

blockers.reason: forecast_run has no forecast_request_id, request_hash, model-profile, validation-dataset, assumption-profile, or as-of fields; backtest_metrics is not a request-authority container.
capability_model has no dedicated fields; placing these governance bindings inside validation_metrics would change the semantics of that canonical field.
forecast_result stores only run/target/distribution/probabilities/status and cannot losslessly reconstruct the qualified revision.
counterfactual_run lacks governed locations for these separately qualified semantics; flattening all values into assumptions would make assumptions a shadow schema.

blockers.field: P6RecommendationRevision source forecast/counterfactual refs/objective constraints/allowed action space/applicability/uncertainty/reviewer/audit/supersession/logical-hash
blockers.reason: training_recommendation lacks governed locations for these fields; rationale/proposed_training_items cannot be overloaded as a hidden schema.

forbidden_workarounds: store complete P2/P4/P5/P6 revisions in arbitrary object JSON solely to bypass missing DB authority
encode missing authority fields inside audit.audit_log.old_value/new_value and treat audit as current product state
overload semantically unrelated jsonb columns such as validation_metrics, backtest_metrics, rationale, proposed_training_items, or assumptions as an undocumented shadow schema
add tables/columns/migrations while DB schema remains frozen at 1.6.0
allowed_b2_work_while_blocked: object/Parquet staging, sealing, enumeration and orphan recovery
P3 adapter implementation where exact derivations are pinned and tested
schema-fit tests and Authority Change Proposal design
